shapeSummary: 72 mm diameter, 30 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered on X and Z, spanning Y 0 to 72. It has a 14 mm through bore, four 4 mm through holes on a 16 mm square pattern, and 16 round pockets (8 mm diameter, 10 mm deep) on each face, centered on a 27 mm radius, approximating the spoke cutouts.
warnings: Wheel width of 30 mm is estimated from the render, not stated in the product data.
The 4 mm pattern hole diameter is assumed.
Spoke pockets are simplified to round holes with an assumed depth of 10 mm per side; the real profile is a contoured, hourglass-like shape.
The pockets are placed on a 27 mm radius, outside the plastic core.
The render appears to show more holes in the core (a ring of about 8) than the 4 given in the analysis; only the 4-hole square pattern is modeled.
The core recess/cup, the plastic-versus-rubber split, tread pips and logos are omitted.
cadquery:
tire = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(36).extrude(15, both=True)
pk = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=5).polarArray(27, 0, 360, 16).circle(4).extrude(11)
pk2 = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-16).polarArray(27, 0, 360, 16).circle(4).extrude(11)
tire = tire.cut(pk).cut(pk2)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(7).extrude(20, both=True)
holes = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(8, 8), (-8, 8), (-8, -8), (8, -8)]).circle(2).extrude(20, both=True)
part = tire.cut(bore).cut(holes).translate((0, 36, 0))
